item.title: Santoor crosses Rs 2,850 crore in sales after nearly four decades in the Indian market
item.description: New Delhi: Santoor, a soap brand from Wipro Consumer Care & Lighting, has recorded company-invoiced sales of Rs 2,850 crore over the past 12 months. Launched initially as a test product in Bengaluru in 1985 and rolled out nationally in 1986, Santoor began with a sandalwood-and-turmeric formulation positioned around the promise of “younger-looking skin”.
